sections.title: Morning Shift (06:30 – 14:30)
items: Equipment received: 5x Keys, 2x Swipe Cards, 3x Vests, Ops Phone, 2x Bodycam, 2x Radio.
Arrived on site; debriefed with night shift; standing by for second guard.
Notifying managers of no-show for second guard; will go patrol alone.
Ahmid picked up; calling guards to see who is available to work.
No answer from guards; heading out to patrol.
Ahmid advised to standby at the office to await further orders; any call requiring our assistance to be notified to him first to assess whether it warrants breaking SOP.
Update from Ahmid: patrol and hand out Heart of the City calling cards to businesses or persons who don't have them or request one.
Responding to a call from Britomart McDonald's regarding a petty theft at their location.
Gave our calling card to the new store WCosmetics on Queen St with a brief description of the service we provide.

Arrived at McDonald's Britomart; received a photo from the store manager — a male had stolen an order belonging to another customer and left, then returned and sat in the lobby. Requested to trespass the individual when found; standby.

Call from Mirrou regarding a female POI already trespassed from the store who entered and stole items, last seen heading up Victoria St. History of aggressive and violent behaviour. Description: all black, fair skin, Maori, red hair (out), black Nike bag, greyish shoes, tattoo on the side of her face. No photo yet; manager to try to provide a photo or CCTV.
Ran up Wyndham St, Albert St, the Sky Tower area and Woolworths; no sign of the POI.
Commotion at the bottom of Mecca — vagrants arguing and yelling at another vagrant; stood by for presence and welfare check on the victim POI being harassed; standby.
Heading towards Darby St for welfare checks on stores.
Lumi Cafe, Celine, Recycle Boutique, Pizza Club all clear; heading to check businesses near HQ on Queen St.
Second guard finally arrived; heading upstairs to update report and do Auror reports.
Falun Dafa Chinese parade heading up Queen St; showing security presence.
Response call from Ban-mi requesting assistance to move loitering vagrants along from the venue.
Vagrants moved along, no further issues.
Standing by HQ for response calls whilst ops phone is charging.
Afternoon shift deployed; morning shift complete, no issues.

sections.title: Afternoon / Evening Shift (14:30 – 22:30)
items: Equipment received: 5x Keys, 2x Swipe Cards, 2x Vests, 1x Ops phone.
Ops phone charging; standing by at office for calls.
Commencing patrol on Queen St toward Aotea Square; welfare check on Nike, Cotton On, Ippondo, Sale Shop, Unichem, McDonald's Queen St, Footlocker, Smiths and Caugheys, all clear.
Aotea Square full sweep, all clear; standing by.
Full sweep Queen St completed, no issues; TK Square all clear.
Commercial Bay all clear; areas around Commercial Bay including the bus interchange clear; standby at TK Square.
Wilson Carpark, Gore St all clear; Fort Lane all clear.
Pioneer Women's Memorial Hall check, all clear.
Full sweep Chancery Square, Freyburg Square, all clear.
Elliot Stables and Jungle 8 welfare check, all clear; standing by for calls.
No response calls; continuing patrol heading to Victoria.
Victoria St welfare check complete, no further issues.
Federal St and the Cathedral welfare check complete, no issues; heading to Albert St.
Welfare check on Albert Mart complete, no issues on Albert St; headed to Commercial Bay.
Customs St no issues; arriving at Commercial Bay.
Commercial Bay, Tyler St, Commerce St sweeps complete, no issues.
Gore St welfare sweep on Giapo, Harbour Suites, liquor store, convenience store, Chargrill, King Noodles, no issues; making our way back onto Queen St.
Wyndham St no issues; no issues on Queen St.
Welfare sweeps complete, no issues; standing by for response calls whilst maintaining presence.
Heading down to Slavery and Sons to deploy security.
Guard deployed at Slavery; resuming patrol.
Quay St no issues; standing by at Reign n Pour as the guard onsite is overtired due to being overworked; standby Kemuri.
Assessed the guard; seems competent to drive; will ride as passenger to the office to assess his driving capability.
Arrived at the office standing by for replacement guard; guard given food and drinks to help with his fatigue.
2nd guard arrived; standing at HQ to charge ops work phone.

sections.title: Night Shift (22:30 – 06:30)
items: Arrived at Queen Street McDonald's, standing by till guard arrives on site.
Stood down security standby for Queen Street McDonald's; continuing patrols down Queen St.
Full sweep Vulcan Lane, Shortland St, Fort Lane, Fort St; welfare check on Shortland Minimart, 77Convenience store, Jo&Joes, The Right Track, all clear; heading down to Britomart.
Arrived at Britomart; standing by due to a large number of minors on bikes; commencing sweep and welfare checks along the way.
Full sweep Britomart; welfare check McDonald's, all clear, no issues identified.
Removed alcohol from a female individual, all clear, no issues.
Welfare check Kemuri, Reign n Pour, all clear.
Received a response call from Britomart McDonald's regarding a male vagrant causing a disturbance inside.
Arrived; approached the male vagrant and kindly asked him to leave; fully compliant but shouting outside; standby.

Members of the public approached us and notified us of a male individual who had been following them for some time; they felt very unsafe and did not want to leave the area; standing by with them and waiting for their Uber to escort them safely.
Group of females successfully escorted safely to their Uber, all clear; heading up Albert St.
Full sweep Quay St, all clear.
Patrolling up Queen St, heading to Bar101 for welfare check.
Arrived at Bar101 standing by showing presence till closing, then continuing patrols.
Encountered a male individual with a damaged ear; assisted the individual. Heading back to office afterwards to charge ops phone.
Arrived at HQ charging ops phone due to low percentage (shown on camera).
Check on Darby St, Elliott Street, all clear.
Patrolling up Victoria St, all clear; welfare check on 77Convenience store, all clear.
Patrolling Federal St towards Wyndham Street, all clear.
Patrolling down Wyndham St towards lower Queen St, all clear.
Patrolling Fort Lane, Fort St, bottom of High St, all clear.
Full sweep Chancery Square and Freyberg Square, all clear; heading back to HQ to commence 30-min break.
Patrolling upper Queen St till handover.
Night shift concluded; handover to morning shift complete.
Media on file: WhatsApp images and videos (18–19 Jul 2026).
